Hoang Yen offers good bang for your ¥en, and with luck for your buck too!
Apr 2019 • Friends
Excellent variety of food, even if the quality is not so great. Lots of street food, including dishes that are hard to find in restaurants, like duck in embryo (hột vịt lộn or balut), or bột chiên (like Singapore carrot cake). Most amazing is the price: less than USD15 per head. no wonder some (mainly western) backpackers spend hours there.
Written April 30, 2019
